brief:
Israeli occupation forces bulldozed Palestinian agricultural land and uprooted olive trees in areas south of Jenin, Shehab Wire reported. The operation targeted farmland in the occupied West Bank, destroying crops and vegetation across multiple plots in the region south of the city.

The demolition represents the latest in a series of Israeli military operations affecting Palestinian property and livelihoods in the Jenin governorate. Olive groves are a primary source of income for many Palestinian farmers in the West Bank. The incident underscores the ongoing pattern of land seizure and agricultural destruction in the territory under Israeli military control.
